title: The Brunei Half Marathon 2026 Review: A 21K Across the SHOAS Bridge
seo_title: Brunei Half Marathon 2026 Review | Bandar Seri Begawan Race
meta_description: The Brunei Half Marathon 2026: November 21 at SHOAS Bridge, Bandar Seri Begawan. 21K, 10K, and 5K with registration open — one of Southeast Asia's rarest country ticks reviewed.
dek: Set for 21 November 2026 at the SHOAS Bridge in Bandar Seri Begawan, this half marathon offers three distances with registration open. A rare opportunity to race in the Sultanate with a bridge-crossing course.
verdict: The Brunei Half Marathon 2026 is one of only a handful of road races in Brunei — and with registration open across three distances (21K, 10K, 5K), it's actually bookable. The SHOAS Bridge venue in Bandar Seri Begawan provides a landmark course feature, and the November date catches the tail of the inter-monsoon period. For country-tick collectors and runners wanting a half marathon in one of Southeast Asia's most under-visited nations, this is a compelling — and rare — option.

sections.heading: Brunei: The Rarest Country Tick
paragraphs: Brunei has one of Southeast Asia's smallest running calendars. [1] A half marathon here with open registration is a genuinely rare opportunity. The SHOAS Bridge — one of Bandar Seri Begawan's landmark structures — provides a distinctive course feature over the Brunei River.
